samples.stimulus: The two-way table shown summarizes the responses of hikers in a park study, sorted by trail. A researcher compares the two groups.
samples.question: What is the positive difference between the probability that one of the ridge trail hikers chosen at random carried a paper map and the probability that one of the valley trail hikers chosen at random carried a paper map?
samples.explanation: (1) 표에서 칸을 읽는다: ridge trail hikers — 55, 33; valley trail hikers — 57, 42. (2) ridge trail hikers 합계 88, valley trail hikers 합계 99 이다. (3) P(응답 | ridge trail hikers) = 55/88 이다. (4) P(응답 | valley trail hikers) = 57/99 이다. (5) 차 = |55·99 - 57·88| ÷ (88·99) = 429/8712 이다. (6) 기약분수로 13/264 이다. 따라서 정답은 13/264이다.
